title: hypericum alpinum var. latifolium
intro: Hypericum alpinum var. latifolium, commonly known as Alpine St. John's Wort, is a plant species in the Hypericum genus, characterized by its broad leaves and yellow flowers. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression due to its health benefits, such as promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Alpine St. John's Wort include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions and are often used in traditional medicine and herbal remedies.
